title.en: Two years of fire seasons, seen from orbit
title.pt: Dois anos de temporadas de fogo, vistos da órbita
title.es: Dos años de temporadas de fuego, vistos desde la órbita

source: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio, "Active Fires As Observed by VIIRS, 2024-Present" (SVS 5113). https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5113/

extraction.note: Frames: one every 5 days, 13 Nov 2024 to 13 Nov 2026, from NASA's 30 fps MP4 scaled to 960x480 (each NASA frame already shows a moving 5-day window of detections, so consecutive frames here do not overlap). Dates follow the date printed on the frame. Value: the share of each region's pixels drawn in fire colours (red channel > 70 and red minus blue > 35; the base map is black land and dark blue sea). It measures how much of the region's map is covered by fire detections. It is NOT a count of fires and NOT fire radiative power: at this size the dots blend with the background, so their colour cannot be read against the 0-8 MW colour bar. Compared with the same measure on 2048x1024 frames the correlation is 0.996 or better for the three regions; the small frames read about 25% higher because the dots blur.

intro.en: Fires around the world seen by the VIIRS satellite instruments, from November 2024 to November 2026, a visualization by NASA. Each tick is fifteen days. The tone is Africa north of the equator. The roar is Africa south of the equator. The pitch of the tick is South and Southeast Asia. Listen to the fire season cross the equator and come back.
intro.pt: Queimadas pelo mundo vistas pelos instrumentos VIIRS em satélites, de novembro de 2024 a novembro de 2026, uma visualização da NASA. Cada tique são quinze dias. O tom é a África ao norte do equador. O rugido é a África ao sul do equador. A altura do tique é o Sul e Sudeste da Ásia. Ouça a temporada de fogo atravessar o equador e voltar.
intro.es: Incendios en el mundo vistos por los instrumentos VIIRS en satélites, de noviembre de 2024 a noviembre de 2026, una visualización de la NASA. Cada tic son quince días. El tono es África al norte del ecuador. El rugido es África al sur del ecuador. La altura del tic es el Sur y Sudeste de Asia. Escucha la temporada de fuego cruzar el ecuador y volver.
